name: Cameras (RTSP)
description: Any camera with local RTSP, watched and recorded by this server.
author: LocalAssistant

device.title: Add a camera
device.description: Any camera with local RTSP (Tapo with a camera account, Reolink). The server keeps the live view and, if you want, records it. The address is stored encrypted.

fields.name: url
fields.label: RTSP address
fields.description: Tapo: stream1 is full quality, stream2 the small one.
fields.message: Paste the camera's RTSP address, like rtsp://user:password@192.168.1.60:554/stream1.

fields.name: record
fields.label: Record on the server, in five-minute files

fields.name: retentionDays
fields.label: Keep recordings for (days)
fields.description: Older files are deleted. A 1080p camera fills roughly 20 GB a day.
